## What Changed?

What does this fix or improve? Link an issue if there is one.

## How Did You Check It?

List commands and results. For UI changes, include browser/device sizes. For agent changes, say whether you used a fixture or a real CLI. Mention anything you couldn't test.

## Before Sending

- [ ] Tests didn't touch working sessions or deployed services. Any billable check had permission.
- [ ] No keys, state files, downloads, or private terminal content are included.
- [ ] The docs match the behavior, including backend-specific limits.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this code under the project's MIT license and have kept any required third-party notices.
